summary.headline: Astrological Inception Chapters
summary.text: Astrological chapter list covering suitable signs in inceptions, planetary rulerships, rain omens, lost objects, universal precepts, truth and friendship inquiries, fornication, and Rhetorius chapters on sects, configurations, decimation, dignity, application, conjunctions, planetary rejoicing, spear-bearing, and related outcomes. Cross-references cite Codex Florentinus 7 and the Catalogo Florentino.
